messages:
Maya Cheng: Kicking off staged shift for inference-model v2.3.0 — moving from 7% to 25% traffic now. Change window ends 2026-03-21 22:00 PT. Watch latency, p95, and 5xx. If errors > 2% or p50 > 250ms call hold/rollback.
DeployBot: starting rollout: model=inference-model:v2.3.0, from=7%, to=25%, mode=staged, author=@maya, link=https://deploys.internal/abc123
Samir Patel: are we pinning the route to v2.3.0 for this wave or leaving ability to fallback to older variant?
Maya Cheng: we're pinning the canary cohort to v2.3.0 only for the duration. fallback route configured to v2.2.8-quant if health fails. (pin command already queued).
Lee (oncall): quick heads up — initial metrics (first 3m): p50=190ms, p95=420ms, error-rate=0.6% global. EU shows slightly higher p95 ~ 480ms.
Zara Kim: noted. ops team will watch EU edge. If error-rate crosses 2% sustained over 2 min + p95 jump, we hit hold. :eyes:
ops-bot: alert scheduled: canary-health-monitor will check 30s windows for p95, 5xx, tail latency regressions.
DeployBot: rollout progress: 12% -> 18% -> 25% (complete). duration 6m.
Lee (oncall): post-shift snapshot (at +8m): global p50=205ms, p95=710ms, error-rate=3.1% (error spike driven by eu-west qps increase).
Samir Patel: oof 3.1% 5xx. Can someone pull errors by stack?
Maya Cheng: pulling traces now. If it's model-side we should partial rollback to 10% and pin to v2.2.8 for the rest of window. I prefer partial rollback first so not full user impact.
Zara Kim: agree. call: HOLD and partial rollback to 10%. ops, please execute route pin to v2.2.8 for 90% traffic.
Lee (oncall): executing: `routes set inference-model traffic: v2.3.0=10% v2.2.8=90%`
DeployBot: running rollback-plan: phase=partial, target_distribution={v2.3.0:10,v2.2.8:90}, initiated_by=@lee, run_id=rbk-1768504321-a
DeployBot: rollback notice: scaled back v2.3.0 to 10% in ~45s.
Lee (oncall): post-rollback metrics (+2m): p50=195ms, p95=360ms, error-rate=0.9% — trending down.
Samir Patel: good quick reaction. Does CI/QA have a reproducer?
Maya Cheng: QA run on the feature flag didn't catch the tail edge-case (long context combo). I've captured failing prompts and will open an eval ticket.
Zara Kim: next steps: 1) pin routing until root cause determined (Maya + infra). 2) add a canary regression test for the prompt pattern. 3) update release notes to reflect the rollback and known issue.
Maya Cheng: filing ticket: INF-4279 "v2.3.0 p95 regression on long-context prompts" with samples + traces. Also updating release notes draft to mark v2.3.0 as "paused" for general rollout.
Samir Patel: who signs off on unpausing? need perf regression fixed + passing canary for 30m with p95 within 10% of baseline and errors < 0.5%
Maya Cheng: agreed. I'll keep this thread updated. ping @zara when we get a fix.
Zara Kim: thanks — marking the week change window. ops will not resume shift without explicit PM/eng approval here. :white_check_mark:
